name: Scarecrow
description: A ragged scarecrow on a cross pole in a heap of earth, about 1.6 × 0.45 × 2.05 m: a patched old coat with straw out of the cuffs and hem, a rope belt, a stuffed sack head with a stitched face and a battered wide-brimmed hat.
